<system-reminder>
A skill is a reusable set of task-specific instructions. The following skills are available in this session:

<available_skills>
- `academic-grant-writing`: Grant proposal writing for Chinese academic contexts — outline, section-by-section body text (立项依据、研究目标与内容、研究方案、创新点、研究基础), reference integration, quality self-review. Use for a grant proposal (基金申请书), project application (项目申报书) or research plan, especially NSFC youth/surface/key projects. Trigger words include 基金、申请书、项目申报、立项依据.
- `academic-paper-writing`: Academic paper writing from outline to final draft — IMRaD and Literature Review, bilingual abstracts, LaTeX (.tex) with BibTeX resolved from DOI, compiled by latexmk. Use to write, outline, revise, abstract or quality-check a paper (写论文、学术论文、论文大纲、写摘要、修改论文). For a quick markdown review without LaTeX use academic-search; for a grant proposal use academic-grant-writing.
- `academic-search`: Academic literature search and review — finds papers, reads them, and synthesizes a cited review. Use for literature discovery (查文献、找文献), a literature review or survey (文献综述、文献调研), or a written answer that must be grounded in published literature. Do NOT use for ordinary technical or coding questions answerable from the repo, docs or general knowledge. For a LaTeX paper or a grant proposal use academic-paper-writing / academic-grant-writing instead.
- `hardworking-paper-writer`: Revise an academic paper sentence by sentence with the author, stripping AI writing tells while preserving their own voice. Use when the user wants to polish, tighten, proofread or de-slop a paper, draft, abstract or thesis chapter — careful interactive sentence-level revision, not a one-shot rewrite. Triggers: 改论文, 润色, 去AI味, "help me revise my paper", "go through my abstract line by line". Needs a .tex/.md/.txt source.
- `paper-review-helper`: Copilot for peer review of someone else's paper. Use when reviewing a research paper (PDF/LaTeX) — section-by-section analysis, a classified issue log, inline problem markers, decision support, and a structured review response (REVIEW.md). For reviewing YOUR OWN draft against your own questions, use academic_review_draft instead.
- `research-slide`: Turn a research figure or result into a Chinese defense/report slide (答辩/组会/项目汇报) as beamer + LaTeX, compiled to PDF. Triggers: 做成答辩ppt, 把这张图做成幻灯片, 组会/答辩/汇报用的slide, research highlight slide, 把figure X重新组织成一页, 按这个模版做. Optimized for physics/materials/quantum figures. Restrained navy/red style: statement banner, two-column argument, boxed conclusion. For the paper body itself use academic-paper-writing.
</available_skills>

If the user names a skill, or the task clearly matches a skill's description, call the `skill` tool with the exact skill name before taking task actions. Load all applicable skills, then follow their full instructions. This catalog contains summaries only; do not infer or follow a skill's instructions until it has been loaded.
A user may also invoke a skill directly; its <skill_content> block then appears in this conversation. Follow it, and do not call the `skill` tool again for that skill.
</system-reminder>
